transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... I’ve been having these evenings where I get a big takeout order, like enough for a family, and then I’ll pick up chips or bakery stuff too. And I end up eating most of it myself before I really notice how much I’ve had.
How often do these evenings of eating a large amount of food by yourself happen?
I’ve been keeping a journal, and… looking back, there’s barely been a week in the last few months where it didn’t happen at least once. Most weeks, it’s several nights.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating or control how much you're eating during these episodes?

Yeah. I mean… once I start, it’s like something flips. I can be telling myself, Taylor, stop, put it away, and I’m still opening the next container. It doesn’t really feel like I’m the one in charge then.
Do you usually feel guilty or ashamed after these episodes of eating a large amount of food by yourself?
I don’t know… I try not to think about it too much after. It’s not exactly a good feeling, but… yeah, I’m not sure how to put it.
Do you feel guilty or ashamed after these episodes of eating a large amount of food by yourself?
I… I don’t know. I don’t really sit with it, if that makes sense. I usually just want to clean up and not think about it. Some of it feels bad, but I’m not sure I’d call it guilt or shame.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating during these episodes?
Not really. Once I start, it’s like that switch flips… I can be thinking, Taylor, put it away, stop now, and my hands just keep going. Opening more containers. It doesn’t feel like I’m in charge.
Do you usually feel like you've lost control during these episodes of eating a large amount of food by yourself?
Yeah… I guess I do. Like I said, once I start, it’s like something switches, and even if I’m telling myself to stop, I’m still opening things and eating. It doesn’t feel like I’m the one in charge.
Are you usually eating because you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset when these episodes happen?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close attention to what I’m feeling right before. Sometimes I’m just… there, and then it happens.
Do you ever try to make up for these episodes of eating by doing things like exercising, vomiting, or using laxatives?
I… I don’t really know. I don’t think so? I mean, I haven’t been keeping track of anything like that.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after one of these eating episodes?
I don’t… I don’t really know. I don’t think I do that. It’s not something I’ve really kept track of.
Do you ever use laxatives after one of these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
I’m not sure. I don’t really think I use them for that… it’s not something I’ve paid much attention to.
Do you ever do anything to try to counteract the amount of food you ate during these episodes?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I do anything specific to make up for it… I just kind of try not to think about it afterward.
Do you ever fast or severely restrict your food intake after one of these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
I’m not sure… I don’t really think I fast on purpose. Sometimes I might eat less after, but I don’t really keep track of it.
Do you ever try to burn off the calories from these eating episodes through excessive exercise?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’m not someone who goes and works out hard after… I haven’t really noticed doing that.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
No… I don’t think I’ve done that. I mean, I feel bad after, but I don’t make myself throw up.
Have you ever made yourself vomit after one of these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
No… I don’t make myself vomit after. I know you asked, but… no.
Do you ever use laxatives after one of these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
No… I don’t use laxatives after. That’s not something I do.
Do you ever try to burn off the calories from these eating episodes through excessive exercise?
Not really. I mean… I don’t go work out or anything to make up for it.
Do you ever fast or severely restrict your food intake after one of these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
I… I don’t really know. I don’t think I do anything like that on purpose after.
Do you ever use any methods to try to counteract or make up for the amount of food you ate during these episodes?
I don’t think so. I mean… not in any real way. I mostly just feel bad about it afterward, but I don’t really do anything to make up for it.
